structure.unit: Licenses for Waterfowl Blinds and for Hunting Waterfowl

law.text:
The fees for waterfowl blind licenses shall be as follows or as such fees may be subsequently revised by the Board pursuant to § 29.1-103:
For a stationary blind erected in the public waters or on the shores of the riparian owner to shoot over the public waters, seventeen dollars and fifty cents.
For a floating blind, in the public waters, to shoot over the public waters, thirty-five dollars.
